cited_by.title: Receding hairline and hair transplants in Black men

record.population: 2,136 men from Ghana, Nigeria, Senegal and South Africa
record.design: Genotyping and genome-wide association for self-reported baldness at age 45
record.finding: Polygenic scores from European studies predicted baldness poorly in these men (AUC 0.513 to 0.546); 51 independent associations were found.
record.note: Genetic prediction, not a treatment study.
